source_lineage.excerpt:
*  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that ensures an explicit
    transaction would be used.  Transaction would only be closed
   after data is completely read from database.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  First time running upon server startup caused transaction to
   close before data is completely read from database.

To help resolve the problem, complete the following steps: 

1. Enable tracing. 

2. Change the trace level to capture business process definition (BPD) and service operations with the following trace: *=info:WLE.*=all 

3. Run the application code again. 

4. Locate the exception, and the thread ID, which is the string after the time stamp. See the following example exception:
00001655 wle E CWLLG2015E: An unexpected runtime exception occurred. See exception for more details. 

5. Search the log files prior to this exception for the thread id 00001655

The following code shows the ProcessItem that is being called. The scriptSource is also present, which gives a hint as to the starting block of the server script that will be executed.

*  A fix that properly handles the order of context dependencies is
    planned for inclusion in IBM BPM V8.5.7 cumulative fix 2017.03.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  No additional information is available.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  If process applications imported from WebSphere Lombardi Edition
   use the TWTimePeriod JavaScript object and the version of the
   System Data toolkit does not match the version of IBM Business
   Process Manager (BPM) V8.5.5 or later releases, you see the
   exception.

*  Upgrade the version of the System Data toolkit to match the
   version of IBM BPM you have.
